name: The Shanghai Commercial & Savings Bank, Ltd.
summary: The Shanghai Commercial & Savings Bank, Ltd. provides various commercial banking services in Taiwan and Hong Kong. The company offers time, savings, demand, checking, and negotiable certificate of deposit accounts, as well as remittance services. In addition, it offers traveling, human resources, insurance, microfinance, leasing, real estate, nominee, trustee, commodity trading, property holding, IT application, securities brokerage, and property management services. Further, the company is involved in the purchase, evaluation, auction, and management of creditor's right of financial institutions; and investing in exchange fund bills and notes, and bonds.
